text.tspan: After store close, POS logs are loaded into Essbase
At night, after Essbase has POS product counts,
StoreSrv and Cloud run batch analysis for the day.
will again call VINX API to soft-stop POS
Human-in-the-loop feedback closes the MLOps cycle

svg.text: Handle pricing, totals, receipt as usual
Nightly upload of movement_summary + video clips
Retrieve POS product counts from Essbase
POS shows pseudo error / assistance request
curate data → retrain/tune → validate → register new version
Use updated model for future detections
